t:
You do not have enough money, sirmadam. {price} measures of Spark energy are required.

I cannot take you anywhere for free, I'm sorry.

Where would you like to go, sirmadam?

{NoUnlock}
r189500.n: Where would you like to go, sirmadam? {NoUnlock}

t: Interesting things are happening here, in Hirkalla's court...
r189506.n: Interesting things are happening here, in Hirkalla's court...

t:
The same way you got to the Cave of Wonders on Suslanger - I'll create an experimental portal. I don't want to use the secret trails right now - it will take too long without the Wanderer, and we'll end up next to the Well anyway.

It will be harder to get to the deep Astral, but that can wait.
Well, that's good! It's time for the second part of the plan.
I'll teleport us straight to the Fodiator! Then I'll use the Seal as a ritual table. You and the jinns will cover me. You won't even need to leave the ship.

Very good. I knew you were a smart boygirl.

Follow the instructions of my faithful generals... By the way, I owe you for them, so thank you. While you are at it, you can find out more about these "odd people out", since they interest you so much.
r189517.n: Alright, I agree. What do I need to do?

t:
Open your eyes!

It's the Light! There is only one road for them - the road of "good" which they defined for themselves, giving themselves the right to judge and punish.

They will not listen to your arguments, they decided everything for themselves long ago, and their decision will not change. As soon as you disagree with them on something, you are their enemy.

Their Light is not mercy, it's justice! Cruel and merciless. They see us all as a crowd of savages approaching their sparkling city on the hill. Like a jungle that wants to destroy the garden they created. How do they deal with the jungle? They clear it away.
r189518.n: Are you sure Enod is a threat to Sarnaut?

t:
Let me explain in simple terms. My sister is deceitful from top to toe. I know you've been in regular contact with her. She always comes up with something, trying to manipulate everyone, inventing all sorts of schemes...

Now she is stalling for time - until the forces of other gods, supporters of the All-Mother, arrive in Sarnaut. That's why she created some new legend that she fed you after your adventures in the land of cute fluffy Gibberlings. But I will give you the truth.

There are two forces - me and my enemies. I'm talking about these bigoted fanatics in their Cathedral, which I can't reach yet. Help me end them - I will give you everything you want. Do you want to rule the Empire? Tomorrow Yasker will look for a new job. Do you want countless treasures? I will build you a city of gold. Reveal all the secrets of the world? Zayan will ask you to teach him.

You know, you seem like an intelligent creature to me. Think about it - what fate? What is fate, anyway? Someone out there decided who everyone would be, and we have no choice in the matter?

That's my mother's nonsense that she put into people's heads. Things like "Fate itself determined your destiny: you, Hirkalla, you naughty child, will fiddle with the dead, but your little sister gets flowers and bunnies. Now accept it and don't complain."

Nonsense! I choose my own path. And no one can tell me what to do!
r189520.n: Alice is worried about the "odd people out".

t: Sarn created perfect destroyers. That's exactly what I need. With them, I can change the whole universe!
r189521.n: Sarn created perfect destroyers. That's exactly what I need. With…

t:
What else? Would you like to serve me, ? Excellent. Speak with my generals - they will have plenty of tasks for you. If you earn enough respect, you will be rewarded.

We won't let anyone out of the city for now - it's too dangerous. These creatures are everywhere... I'll deal with most of it, but it will take time, but for now the barricades will remain in place.

Await further instructions.
r189522.n: What else? Would you like to serve me, ? Excellent. Speak with my…

t:
To be below or above is to be at the end or the beginning of the path of my fate.

If you see my fate, can you see my tracks, can you follow them from end to beginning?

Can you "fall upwards"?
r189652.n: It's too high for me to climb.

t: I don't remember the way... I've been here for so long... The last thing I remember is falling from a height.
Thank you! I escaped from Aisa, but many could not. The Fateweavers still caught up with me. If it weren't for you...
r189654.n: Thank you! I escaped from Aisa, but many could not. The Fateweavers…

t: Perhaps right now I'm closer than ever to getting answers to my questions...
r189726.n: Perhaps right now I'm closer than ever to getting answers to my…

t: Ahh! Damned obscurantists! They won't embrace gender equality! You hear "What should we do?" and "Who is to blame?", but I went and opened a sewing workshop and created a place for women where they could realize their full potential! And now I'm going to study medicine too!
Let us celebrate the emancipation of women!
r189732.n: Let us celebrate the emancipation of women!

t:
It all started with the university... First Alice showed up and organized a club. She explained why her sister's rule was bad. Then this Verkhovensky came. He threatened everyone and bullied them into frankpledge, made them spy on each other...

Even those who initially had doubts were forced to take part in everything he planned... And those who refused mysteriously disappeared...
You were all fooled... You believed it was easy to change the world...
r189737.n: You were all fooled... You believed it was easy to change the world...

t: Iaver Bazar opened my eyes! Down with authorities! I'm an old acquaintance of this great scholar. I owe him my rebirth... When I heard Iaver Bazar say we shouldn't recognize authorities, I felt so elated... as though I had seen the light! Down with authorities! Down with the Great Mages! Down with the gods!
r189741.n: How did you end up here?

t: When I heard Iaver Bazar say we shouldn't recognize authorities, I felt so elated... as though I had seen the light!
r189742.n: When I heard Iaver Bazar say we shouldn't recognize authorities, I…

t:
Not what... Who!

Her name is... Aisa. Now she is here - in our world... The fates of the people she came across were changed, pulled out of the general pattern. Aisa can change my fate or yours.

But it's... meaningless. I still couldn't become what I wanted... I'm not a "person"...
r189759.n: What led you to this idea?

t:
Thus, villainy is permissible if the goal is good. The whole world is divided into people and nonentities.

I imagined that I, too, was a genius, a destroyer, and for some time I truly believed it. I needed to know as soon as possible whether I'm a nonentity or a person. Will I be able to cross a line? Am I brave enough to reach for something and take it? I'm a person...?

I came up with the theory, but I was not able to actually do it, to go for it... so that means I'm not who I thought I was.

It wasn't the money I needed, I needed something else...

I wrote an article for a newspaper some time ago...

An idea occurred to me: since ancient times, outstanding people have sacrificed the weak without hesitation! How many died during the Great Experiment? And how many people did Tep kill for the sake of his research? My idea was this: people, according to the law of nature, are divided into two categories: the bottom - the material that serves only to produce its own kind, and the worthy people who have a gift or talent...

These people are destroyers, those who destroy the present for greater good. In other words, outstanding people like Tep move the world forward. They are given more power than others, and they determine what is allowed and what is not.

After I confessed, Porfiry told me that my punishment will be keeping order on Jigran until I redeem myself. You'll benefit from this, too. Call me and I'll come - I'll serve my sentence and help improve your reputation with the townsfolk.
r189762.n: Well, tell me what you can do.

t: Did I kill the old lady? I killed myself, not her!
r189763.n: Did I kill the old lady? I killed myself, not her!

t: Ah, most honorable sirlady!! Here you are... in our land... Well, let's talk, fathermother! Or maybe you don't like to be called most honorable sirlady and... fathermother...Please don't consider it familiarity...

quests: Problems of the City: Riot at the Police Station

r189771.n: Ah, most honorable sirlady!! Here you are... in our land... Well,…

t: Ahaha! You seem to be confused! Come back once you figure out who is lying and who is telling the truth!
r189809.n: Did I make a mistake somewhere?

t: So you believe Lebezin and Sonya are telling the truth?
r189810.n: You slipped the money to Sonya!

t: Hahaha! That's what I was telling you! She stole the money! So Lebezin and Sonya are lying to you!
r189811.n: You didn't slip the money to Sonya!

t: Suppose I did. Then Lebezin was telling the truth, but Amalia lied to you! What, then? Can you draw the right conclusion?
That would mean Amalia is right, but my treacherous friend Lebezin lied to you! I'm waiting for your conclusions.
Then Sonya is telling the truth, but Ekaterina is lying... So? Let's say I did. What about the 90 rubles?
Then Ekaterina is right, but Sonya is lying! Lying without remorse! That's what I'm saying!
Then it means I lied to you, and Sonya's mother, Ekaterina, also lied or is confused about something... What are you getting at?
r189816.n: You knew Raskolnikov and Sonya were friends.

t: And that means I told you the truth. And so did this floozy's mother, Ekaterina! And if I'm right, then who stole the money?
r189817.n: You didn't know that Raskolnikov and Sonya were friends.

t: Let us suppose that's true. Then I lied to you, and Raskolnikov was telling the truth! What about the money?
r189818.n: You had a fight with Raskolnikov.

t: Then it means I'm telling the truth, and Raskolnikov is lying! Well, how can you prove that I planted the money?

Yes, alas, I know this scoundrel! The thing is, he's my sister's fiancé. But that's in the past now! When he showed up here, I knew right away who he was and told him everything I thought of him. He's been nursing a grudge ever since. He's probably trying to get back at me.
I'm a simple student. I live here and study at the university nearby.
r189829.n: I'm a simple student. I live here and study at the university nearby.

t: You can't help me... Sonya! Daughter! I'm sorry!
It's no use. It looks like he's dead already.
Semyon Marmeladov seems to be crushed under the carriage.
r189837.n: Semyon Marmeladov seems to be crushed under the carriage.

t: Ekaterina saw it and... lost it... There she is, wandering the streets...
This is horrible! He's dead... Oh, Tensess. What a nightmare...
r189849.n: This is horrible! He's dead... Oh, Tensess. What a nightmare...

t: It's the end of the world! Spiders! Spiders everywhere! Murderers!! Murderers!! The end is near... People!!
r189854.n: Yes, he got run over by the carriage... It was an accident!

t: Murderers! Murderers! He stole from us and drank it all away! He ruined my life! And now he's dead! Murderers...
r189855.n: Murderers! Murderers! He stole from us and drank it all away! He…

t: I didn't steal money from him! Yes, he offered me 10 rubles to help us out, but I didn't take the other 90! I didn't even touch it. It must have been planted!
r189860.n: What can you tell me about this situation?

t: It wasn't just arson! It's the dawn of a rebellion! Glory to Alice!

quests: Good Deeds for the City: Questioning Students

r189878.n: What do you know about the arson?

t: Oh, it's not arson. Probably just a prank... But they say a lot of things will burn down soon - police stations, palaces, and even churches... That's what Verkhovensky said...
r189999.n: What do you know about the arson?

t: Is this a conspiracy? It must have been a prank... But I hear a revolution is coming. My opinion? It's nonsense. This is hardly a revolution.
r190000.n: What do you know about the conspiracy?

t: Man is governed exclusively by the calculation of his own advantage. What we call sublime emotion or ideal aspiration-all that, in the general course of life, is completely insignificant in comparison with each person's pursuit of his own advantage.
r190001.n: Man is governed exclusively by the calculation of his own advantage.…

t: Whenever they have a problem, you start fretting over it like a hen with an egg! He never has time, everything annoys him - and he just lies there, doing nothing.
r190105.n: Whenever they have a problem, you start fretting over it like a hen…

t: Ah! Yes, I've heard about it... Some students recently received these... what are they called... components... That can be assembled into... what's it called... an incendiary device!
I heard something recently... Two students received these... what are they called... leaflets! And now they're scattered everywhere! Take a look for yourself. It's garbage, that's what!
r190115.n: What's going on at the university?

t: Soon we will strike again! Praise the Awakened!

quests: Good Deeds for the City: Questioning Students

r190120.n: What do you know about the conspiracy?

t: Long live the revolution! Soon we will overthrow the dark goddess!

quests: Good Deeds for the City: Questioning Students

r190121.n: Long live the revolution! Soon we will overthrow the dark goddess!

t: Thank you so much! I heard... You help everyone...
Life is hard in our city... you'd do many things to get some bread...

quests: Good Deeds for the City: Questioning Students

r190128.n: Life is hard in our city... you'd do many things to get some bread...

t: I was tempted by his money, but I swear I never imagined that he was such an unworthy man. If I had seen through him earlier, he wouldn't have tempted me!
r190147.n: I was tempted by his money, but I swear I never imagined that he was…

t: This Cathedral is an eyesore... It's time for some architectural improvements!
r190168.n: This Cathedral is an eyesore... It's time for some architectural…

t: Books? What do I get in exchange? Spark energy, perhaps? At least three measures.
If you give me some Spark energy, I'll consider it.
r190352.n: Would you like to stop supporting Verkhovensky?

t: I wish it would all start soon!
r190356.n: I wish it would all start soon!

t: You can't love what you don't know!
Our lovers of freedom are first and foremost lackeys and only seek to clean someone's boots.
r190361.n: Our lovers of freedom are first and foremost lackeys and only seek to…

t: When I came to this city ten days ago, I of course decided to take a role. The best thing would be no role at all - just my own face, right? There is nothing more cunning than your own face, because no one will believe it.
r190369.n: When I came to this city ten days ago, I of course decided to take a…

t: You won't regret it! Now listen carefully...
Glad to hear it! But this choice will affect the future, so you need to be absolutely sure of it!
r190378.n: You're right, let's put an end to Hirkalla's rule!

t: I think you'll regret this... Get out of my sight! Go to her...
It pains me to hear this... But I'll ask again. This choice will affect the future, so you need to be absolutely sure of it!
r190380.n: Hirkalla is right, and you've gone mad!

t:
Do you doubt me? Didn't I put an end to Sarn and the Architect by pitting them against each other? I'm doing the same now - bringing together these madmen who rejected the gods, Hiero's Paladins who never question their own righteousness, and Hirkalla's minions who swore allegiance to the Darkness! They will weaken each other, and we will achieve our goals.

Some believe that victory can be achieved without getting your hands dirty, that there is always a simple and honest solution... But not me... And not you. You must understandmust understand - sometimes it's necessary to do things that are not... quite right.

You don't need Hirkalla - I will resurrect the dead myself just as I resurrected the Aviaks and the Tekyan. I will restore this world... my world! Not her.

Oh, do you really want a lecture? You can ask the Healers about it.

Oh, well. I'll be brief.

Every living being, be it a human, elf, orc, animal, or even demon, has a Spark. No one knows what it actually is. You can call it a visible soul.

Free Sparks cannot linger too long in our world - they continually lose energy, fading over time.

In his time, Tep learned to extract it from Sparks. If you catch them, you can take what you need and use it for various purposes.

Your dark girlfriend released all Sparks from the storage that was similar to Tep's Pyramid.

That's why Jigran is full of free energy right now. Free for all.

I represent Nefer Ur and Scientific Council here. We have our own view of Hirkalla and her pets. And Alice - I would love to speak with this elusive individual. By the way, do you have anything to say about this "Resurrection of Tep" that everyone is talking about? I just don't understand - I thought Klavdia had his Spark... How did Hirkalla get her hands on it? Or is that madman not actually Tep?
Take them all with you, and let's head out.
r190407.n: Good, then off we go, to the south!

t: But perhaps you have heard that a Historian expedition has arrived here a little while ago, and there are many Arisen within its ranks. They've managed to unearth some sort of ruins that belonged to our people − one of the ancient outposts situated outside Sardrok. We need to warn them as well. The problem is that the transit between Dar Ulgorn and Sardrok is unreliable, the southern roads have been overrun by the undead, and something odd is happening within the palace itself. That, however, is not our concern, but the missing archaeologists are my headache. I suggest that we four go there and find out what's going on.

Yes. Nefer Ur's order is unambiguous, and not subject to different interpretations. In case of a conflict of interest, it is recommended to leave behind a double. It's a kind of technology devised by ZIT, which allows to create a kind of copy that will be successfully imitating you for a while. As far as I know, the majority of Zem state officials in Nezebgrad have already made use of this service. This is how serious everything is!

We need to take the Arisen that remain here, on Jigran, with us.

As far as I remember, apart from our dearest director of the ZIT, that scientist, Yaver Bazar, also resides in this city. I've summoned both of them here.
r190409.n: All of the Arisen… they have to arrive to Xadagan?!!

r190410.n: What's that plan about, and what needs to be done?

t:
Oh please, no need for all that, . For some odd reason she seems to favor you, so you're the perfect candidate for infiltrating her ranks.

You'll have to play along for a bit.

Do what she says. Kill if she tells you to. Lie if she tells you to. Don't worry about getting your hands dirty. We need to save Sarnaut! By any means necessary!

Hey, hey, just don't get carried away, . You are a spy, not her loyal servant...

Your task is to worm yourself into Hirkalla's confidence. She seems to favor you for some odd reason. Pretend to follow her orders, no matter what she asks of you. And at the right moment... you'll betray her. For the good of Sarnaut!

Understand who interfered with history.

I doubt that it was Nihaz or Hirkalla - I would have known if it was them.

It can't be Cosmos - right now his ability to manipulate the Observatory is very limited.

Someone else is operating on a different level. You and I must find them. I suggest you ask my sister and her minions. They have to know something... I hope you don't mind becoming a spy?

Well, the ghosts are those who died and then came back to life.

They lived in the Old Era. Performed different deeds, both heroic and mundane.

But everything changed for some of the people I knew. They were famous, they were an important part of history. But now...

They are odd people out. Unwanted. Discarded.

I... don't understand who could have done that. I might be the only one remembering the old version of the story.
r190419.n: Tell me what's wrong with the story...

t: Who is Selifan? Do you mean Ivan? I don't remember him, hah! But you know what? If you bring me ten Sparks, it will refresh my memory!
r190440.n: Selifan asked me to pick up a box of wine...

t: Well, buddy! For you and Selifan, I'll spare nothing. If you're planning a boozy evening, don't forget Zlatan!
Uhh, why are you here, buddy? Would you like to try some kebab? Good kebab. Fresh!
r190444.n: Uhh, why are you here, buddy? Would you like to try some kebab? Good…

t: My throat is so dry I don't feel like talking. If you help me with that, I'll tell you everything.
r190450.n: What do you know about the missing ghosts?

t: Do you take me for a fool?
r190546.n: Well, now we found her for sure!

t: My friend, information is valuable. If you do me a favor, I will tell you everything I know.
r190548.n: What do you know about the missing ghosts?

t:
Ah, that dog... It's a pity, yes... But...

I must say the dogs you brought me eat less than she does... and they don't try to eat me! I suppose getting a hound from the Wild Hunt wasn't the best idea...
r190549.n: Take a look - is this Chestnut's collar? Unfortunately, I had to deal with her...

t:
Most of them exist on the verge of transforming into a silent Spark - they don't have enough energy to act without an ether body. They need energy not to become Sparks. You can either take it from other, weaker entities, or someone powerful can grant it to you.

Unfortunately, most decided to harvest Sparks of the other awakened. Those people are called owners of dead souls, and some even sell them.

There are also the distorted creatures of Darkness and mindless ghosts. They are nothing but predators who steal our energy.
I think everyone should learn to love life more than anything else.
r190555.n: I think everyone should learn to love life more than anything else.

t:
My brothers came to Jigran before the dark goddess. The Elves of the House de Delice built this Cathedral to accustom vampire exiles to the Light.

But something else happened - Darkness swallowed the world, and it made its nest here. It wanted to chase away the Paladins, but they stood strong - and then Hirkalla threw her forces at them. But then a miracle occurred - her forces couldn't do anything. A strong shield of faith kept her dark creatures away from the Cathedral.

The number of brothers and sisters grew, and then they summoned me. Then...

You contacted Enod. Three observers came here: Ieziphael, Serahael, and Varadael. With them, our protection grew even stronger.

Then Alice came. I had no reason to trust her, but she explained that she wanted to fight against Hirkalla. I had no objections.

Their clash was... spectacular. The echo of their words resounded throughout the city - you can find it if you want.

Then Alice disappeared. And Hirkalla is sitting in her palace, dreaming of getting rid of us.
A whole ocean of Darkness cannot extinguish a radiant Beacon of Light
r190559.n: A whole ocean of Darkness cannot extinguish a radiant Beacon of Light

t:
I suppose we should join Hiero and his Paladins at the Cathedral on Jigran. Their faith is so strong that they were able to create a protective barrier around the temple.

At the research institute, we have created a device that will allow us to travel to Jigran undetected.

But first, let's pray, . And ask the Light for guidance...
Today you see a heartbroken father. I'm very worried about my daughter... She is in trouble. My daughter went on a long walk... And disappeared!
Not me... The Scissors... The power you let into our world! You played with fate without thinking about the consequences. I couldn't save her. But beware, the scissors are coming for you, !
I'm the one following in your footsteps! Beware, for I am close... You will not escape Fate, !
You are an aberration in the fabric of existence. A blot. A mistake! And I will fix this mistake!
r190596.n: You are an aberration in the fabric of existence. A blot. A mistake!…

t:
Are you ready to hear me out? You won't like what I'm going to say...

Let's walk to the Cathedral...
r190603.n: You are a Paladin, and I'm a hero.

t: I'm glad you are interested in the history of my family. Many of my ancestors provided fine examples to the younger generation. Let's take my father Aniel, who emerged as a hero of Kirah war. He saved Kirah from destruction during the demonic assault. Regretfully, he perished in the war against the Empire. Jasker himself faced him in a duel, and my father did not make it...
r190606.n: Request family tree of de Ardeur

t: Don't stay in the Purgatory too long, or you might get stuck beyond this life forever!
r190608.n: Don't stay in the Purgatory too long, or you might get stuck beyond…

t:
The dark times continue! And every time you seem to be right in the thick of the events.

Everything is much more serious than I supposed. When I asked Herbert to keep his eye on the Historians, I hoped that they would find some crocks or writings that would help us learn more about the history of Sarnaut and Tep's life. But what you found... is unbelievable!

I will meet Izbor and Aidenus, take my best soldiers and set out to Ferris. You go back and don't let the Surveyors do anything stupid!

House de Ardeur is fully devoted to the League.

Renard, my brother and the head of the House, is one of the most active League supporters. It's hard to find a House that is more passionate about our common cause. Aidenus can count on us. Tell him that. We won't leave Kania and the Gibberlings unsupported.

It doesn't mean that we want war. I'm sure the upcoming union of the League and Imperial churches means a long-term peace.
r190611.n: What can you say about the League? What's House de Ardeur's attitude?

t:
But of course.

How can an elf miss this event? Especially when such an important decision is at stake!
r190612.n: Good afternoon! Are you going to the Great Ball?

t:
It's easy.

I'll give you the invitation from King Louis. He heard a lot about you and wants to meet you in person. The letter explains how to get there.

Louis is a crafty politician, a genius of scheming. He used accusations against Armando to gain control over his home allod. When the ruling House is changed, he'll do everything to keep as much control as he can.

Prince Dakkar is his son.

I need you to do something before going there.
r190615.n: How can I get to the Ball?

t:
Each of the seven Great Houses wants victory, of course.

Like in any other race, there are favorites.

Two Houses are leading the race: our House de Ardeur, and House de Delice.

Most importantly, we have different views on many issues. House de Ardeur supports alliance with Kania. House de Delice stands on neutral grounds. They believe that with the truce we can achieve a stable peace.

Each House, except for House de Desirae, has taken sides. We can discuss it later.

The Great Ball is just a part of the Great Game. The Great Game is the reason for living of my people.

Every elf acts for the good of their House. Those who achieve a lot, gain power and influence, and rise over the others.

You need to come up with something truly unique to win the Great Ball. Something substantial. Something that will be valued by everyone, that can make a change.

By the victor's right, the winning House will determine the policies of all elves over the next decades. Until the next Great Ball.
r190617.n: Tell me more about the Great Ball.

t:
Yes. Where should I begin?

Let me start with the events you were part of.

Ten years ago you witnessed House de Doucer's intervention in preparations of the Great Ball on Tenebra. My House was building the Galleon Castle, which was supposed to bring us victory, but Armando didn't let that happen. Tenebra was devoured by darkness. The Ball was postponed.

Over all these years the Ball was brought up on several occasions. And there were reasons to postpone it even further... until now.

The Great Ball will begin shortly. You must take part. You can hardly say no.

, I suppose we should join Hiero and his Paladins at the Cathedral on Jigran. Their faith is so strong that they were able to create a protective barrier around the temple.

My brother sent us a device that will allow us to travel to Jigran undetected.

But first, let's pray. And ask the Light for guidance...

, we have learned a lot over the year and can say for certain that the Goddess of Darkness is not omniscient and not omnipotent. Her strength is limited; she is unable to keep track of everything.

But she is dangerous. Her minions are everywhere, especially here in Novograd. Therefore we will proceed with extreme caution. Our task is to get to a place where she has no power.

I will die before I say anything!
What? Rip out all the gears? From me?! Why you... Why you... Why, I'll...
Darn you anyway, ask! I have lived for many centuries, and I don't want to croak it again in my old age because of some greenhorn. So, what do you want to know?

So... Zimina's clone, who possesses all her skills and memories, is walking around Ferris, threating the expedition and trying to reach some ancient device, for which the Empire once performed miracles of conspiracy? That's just great.

Zimina is right - it's about time we interfered. I will prepare a team of our best fighters and specialists. While I am working on that, you have to reconfigure the portal system on Ferris to let us teleport directly to you. Just don't let the Historians see it.

Is your mission clear? Go back. Let's not waste a minute!
Here you are. Make sure you don't lose it again.
r190820.n: Report about the loss of magical hammer

t: Aho, child! We've been waiting for you. Listen to what I have to say to those who are about to say goodbye to their childhood and enter their adult life.
r190835.n: Aho, child! We've been waiting for you. Listen to what I have to say…

t: Khoor-Shashin has taught you a lesson, zoor? That's good. Wounds make us strronger than rock and harder than steel! Now drrink this potion, it will stop the bleeding.
The Primals don't favor the weak ones. Show that you can fight!
r190837.n: The Primals don't favor the weak ones. Show that you can fight!

t:
Unbelievable... The Enlightened! Ay-hya! You are the Enlightened, the Primals are never wrong!

The gift of Light is the biggest gift that the Primals can give to a young Priden. We have gifted us with fire, the crrafts, the arts of hunting and fighting. But the gift of Light is something very special, eysh! The ones whose tya shines brighter than the stars cannot die of a wound or a sickness. Only old age or a complete destruction of the body can prevent your resurrection.

Anyway, I'm a mere Trainer, and I can't tell you much about the gift of Light. My tya will dissolve in Yao Realm. When the time comes, my tyarra will melt, and a new tyalla will be born through my descendants.

Go to Khuus-Margen, our expert. He is Enlightened, too, so he can tell you about the gift of Light and teach you how to master its power.

You can find him at the blacksmith's shop in the Khuus Camp. There are many outlanders there, who value our hunter's trophies and weapons, so the Khuus Branch, who trrade with them, usually settle close the Port to keep the tailless away from the Residence.

Scar and Baccy... They are the vice! Anger, prride, lie, and hypocrisy. I told you about death that would be standing by your side. You can't win unless you fight your vice! If you give in to the vice, you will die, if you fight for the virtue, you will win! I'm sure you will choose the latter!

Was there anything else I should know about?

Belly symbolizes your inner power. The bear seems to be fat and clumsy, but it's a deceptive imprression. He is smart, strrong, and guileful, but doesn't show it off. He lives in harmony with nature and obeys the Forest Law, which he told you about. He doesn't hunt for fun like we do; he loves nature and only uses its gifts when he can give something in rreturn.

It's a good sign that you met him, eysh!
r190840.n: Tell about Belly and the Forest Law

t:
Oh, I haven't met Mirrah, but other trrainers told me about her grace and dexterity. She is strrong and merciless, and she doesn't accept compromise.

The world is crruel, eysh! But we are hunters, and we are in charrge of our lives. The one who resigns to their fate and accepts the inevitable, becomes prey, eysh!
r190841.n: Tell about Mirrah and the Power of Blood

t:
Boa, the grreat serpent, the Two-Tongued... He is close to spellcasters, trappers, and trrainers like me. His words are wisdom, eysh! Each trainer has met him in the Thicket of the Primals and learned about the essence of things. This knowledge has led us to understanding the world and ourselves.

It's strrange that you've met spirits that are so different from each other. I think the path of your life will be very winding...
r190842.n: Tell about Boa and the essence of things

t: Tell me, whom did you meet in the Thicket of the Primals? What did our ancestors teach you?
r190843.n: Tell me, whom did you meet in the Thicket of the Primals? What did our…

t: Are you with us, Enlightened? I hope the Primals have chosen you for a reason!
Are we under attack? We will fight back! The Golases may be silent, but their power is with us!
r190887.n: Are we under attack? We will fight back! The Golases may be silent,…

t: Huh! There must be some clothes my bag. Yep, this will do.
Are you off your chumps, girlfriend? You're too small even for a female orc, huh! You better ask the bone-legged, Tabhut. You are both skinny!
Huh, that's smart! You want to fool the dumbos, right? That ain't that hard to do. But you better not give yourself away, huh!
r191169.n: Huh, that's smart! You want to fool the dumbos, right? That ain't that…

t: You want to fight with me? I will beat you!
First you will fight with our warriors. I will watch. I am smart, I will learn.
You fight fast. I didn't get it. Will you show again?
I think yes. Fight me! I will defeat you!
Who are you? You're from Uuk's pack? Tell him he's an ass!
r191310.n: Who are you? You're from Uuk's pack? Tell him he's an ass!

t:
I know who you are talking about. His name was Akyn or Akyl, right? He was trying to hit on me back in the Port with his raunchy jokes.

He offered to run our ship to Howlem. There is no way we could have reached it on our own, with all the storms and anomalies! While we were travelling, I came to the deck to take a look at your beautiful allod, and then I saw several Astral boats undocking from the ship ahead and heading to a small shard near your allod. I didn't pay much attention to that, but now it's clear to me that Akyl has sent his accomplices there!

Magical stone? Let me have a look... Oh! Don't you know what it is? It's a June Adventurer's Stone!

This stone is used to create a small Portal and travel to a certain stationary Portal from anywhere in the world! Also, it can arouse magic of ancient June Portals. Although I don't know the required spells. I'm just an ambassador, not a Great Mage. We could use some help from one right now!

The Holy Land is a truly wondrous allod. This ancient land was once home to the June, and after their demise it became home to the Zem. It is also where Tep himself built a colossal pyramid ages ago.

After the final battle of the Great Astral Campaign, this pyramid became home to the soul of Tensess, the Great Kanian Mage. After that the pyramid became known as Tensess Temple, and it is from there that all of the world's Holy magic originates.

The Empire seeks to capture the Temple and take control of the world's Holy magic. That would drain the power from all of the League's priests and paladins. Even worse, it would deprive us of the ability to be reborn after death.

For years now we've been warring with the Empire in the Holy Land. And though our cause is just, victory is a long ways off.
Oh, hello! I was sent here to speak on behalf of the League. Before the Imperial ambassador stuffs your head with their dumb propaganda. Besides, your commander is so... manly.
r191398.n: Oh, hello! I was sent here to speak on behalf of the League. Before…

t:
The world of spirits is just as dangerous as yours, child. You've had to learn the rules of your world to survive, hadn't you, zoor? Now you must learn the rules of the spirits' world, too. First of all, remember - your will sculptures the world like pottery clay. As long as you know what you want, the dangers will pass you by.

Think of your enemies and concentrate on that thought. They are your purpose and your prey. All you need is to obtain their power to summon the patron spirits, and use their help to eliminate the threat that is hanging over Pridens.

Remember about that. Let your instincts do the rest, eysh!
r191406.n: Ask about the dangers of the spirits' world

t: Don't fear anything, child. The spirit' world will tolerate no weakness. I will be your guide, but remember - when the time comes for the final battle, I won't be able to help you. Your victory or your defeat will belong to you solely.
r191407.n: Don't fear anything, child. The spirit' world will tolerate no…

t: These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
r191478.n: These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...

t: Get ready, kylys. Listen to the harmony of the world and open the lock!

We have the key, and we have the lock. They are connected, but you can't turn the key if you put it in upside down, eysh!

Listen and do what I say, kylys. I believe we can make it. The Primals are favoring us!
Greetings, comrade! I've heard that you wish swear allegiance to the great Empire. Good for you! I hope your people will see, too, that the future belongs to the Empire, and join our ranks!
r191502.n: Greetings, comrade! I've heard that you wish swear allegiance to the…

t:
Welcome aboard! This ship's destination is Novograd!

By the way, have you ever been to Novograd? It is the best place in the world. You will love it!

I'm glad that the Imperial ambassadors didn't have time to stuff your head with their propaganda. Their promises are as empty as a bottomless bottle! The League will show you the way of the real adventures!
r191509.n: Welcome aboard! This ship's destination is Novograd! By the way, have…

t:
If the Golases think that the path of your life leads you to the Holy Land, you will need some powerful allies. Even the Enlightened can't survive on their own in the big world, eysh!

The Empire or the League? It's up to you to decide. Both have their merits and flaws. Some favor freedom and dignity of the League, some loyalty and cohesion of the Empire.

Remember - once you have chosen one side, you will become enemies with the other one forever. The war between the League and the Empire has been going on for many centuries, and there will be no end to it. When you join a side, you will find your loyal friends... and your deadly enemies!

What a surprise... The Golases often refuse to accept Pridens to the Branches because of their stupidity, weakness, or vice. Some of our kinsmen refuse to accept the will of the Golases and leave Howlem voluntarily. But the Golases have never sent anyone to find their destiny in the big world, eysh!
r191516.n: What a surprise... The Golases often refuse to accept Pridens to the…

t:
Tya-ah have attacked the Residence! They chase our women and rob our houses! The filthy bastards are everywhere! They came down the mountains and passed the stones! The Guardians didn't stop them!

Pass my message to Tyym-Khos! I am going back. I need to warn the camps!
Get out of the way! I need to report on the attack!
r191523.n: Get out of the way! I need to report on the attack!

t:
The blood on your hands is the blood of a tya-ah, a Priden of the trribe cursed by the spirits and bereft of tyarra!

When the Golases united Priden trribes, some of them refused to follow. When the leaders and the tyrants fell under our onslaught, their henchmen were scattered in the mountains. They kept on attacking us from time to time. And then the Great Disaster came. The world was split apart, eysh! That was a hard time; many has lost their minds. We fought for each piece of brread and each sip of fresh water... The only reason why we survived was that we stayed united! The wisdom of our ancestors and the Golases' will led us through those dark times. And the rest of Pridens... They lost their tyarra, they became tya-ah. They look just like us, but their tya is crippled. Tyalla without tyarra is like a blade without a handle!

When the world was young, grreat heroes were often born among Pridens, eysh! They became leaders, and the others were ready to kill and die on their orrders. They were strong and prroud, and didn't want to share their power with anyone. So our people were divided...

Many moons had passed since. The heroes quarreled and resigned, fought and died, and the ones who trrusted them died by their side. But still there were wise men among the leaders, who loved their people more than wealth and power. They united and confrronted those drunk with blood. They called themselves the Golases of the Pack. Those heroes showed Pridens that strength is in unity!

They trrusted and never betrayed each other. When they overthrew the last leader, they knew that they can't lead all Pridens together. Then young heroes accomplished their grreatest feat - they swore to serve the ones that believed in them forever, and they swore on their own blood, eysh! They sacrificed themselves! But the bravehearts didn't die - their oath kept them in this world. They became the trrue Golases - invisible, unfleshly, but omniscient and infinitely wise.

And so began the Branches. Each Branch lives separately and follows its Golas. He doesn't rule but directs it, doesn't order but suggests, doesn't judge but reconciles... It was solely the wisdom of the Golases that has led us through all the hardships to unity and strength, eysh!
Aho, kinsman! Why are you disturbing me?
r191559.n: Aho, kinsman! Why are you disturbing me?

t:
How come?! Ay-hya! Is it because of me? I didn't mean to!

Those furry creatures - they are called the Gibberlings - asked me to put out the torch lights in the camp. They swore that that was just a joke, eysh! And since I was assigned to light the torches, I got my benefit from that... Those furry deceivers!

They live in another camp, with other tailless outlanders from the League. They wanted me to watch their show instead of the cinema. But I didn't go, I had a lot of things to do.

Please, don't tell anyone, zoor? If the tailless find this out, they won't let me see the cinema!
r191568.n: Say that the cinema was cancelled

t: Are you talking about the rats? Nobody's furry here apart from us and the rats.
Aho, kinsman! You want to watch the cinema, too? They say the spectacle is rather imprresive, eysh!
r191570.n: Aho, kinsman! You want to watch the cinema, too? They say the…

t:
Our church worships three deceased Great Mages - Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan. As I already told you, Tensess gave the Empire and the League citizens the ability to resurrect. Later, when Nezeb and Skrakan - the Great Mages of the Empire and the League, respectively - died while protecting this world from demons, our church sanctified them, and thus transformed into the Trinity Church. We believe that the three Mages watch after us even after their death.

Unfortunately, some do not share our views.

The League Holy Church is the congregation of the most blatant conventionalists in Sarnaut. They refuse to sanctify Nezeb because he belonged to the Empire, and so they don't recognize Skrakan's sacrifice, just because he died together with Nezeb! They still worship Tensess alone, and the Gift that he gave us. Everything else is considered heresy!
r191651.n: Ask about the differences in the factions' religions

t: Avengers are the warriors of Light, who serve the Trinity Church. They are mostly Xadaganian. Orcs who devote their life to the Church are called Reavers. They compensate their poor diplomacy skills with excellence in battle craft. Most orcs just need a good fight and a reason for it. Unfortunately, we can give them both in plenty.

Inquisitors and Heretics form the core of our Church. They help us keep our faith strong in these dark times. Thanks to them, we always remember that even the most impenetrable darkness can give birth to the Light!

Also, they know how to use the Holy magic to fight against demons. The Trinity Church can both stand up for itself, and also protect the Empire from its hideous enemy.

Ah, you’re here. Great.

Recently I discovered a schematic for an old mechanism powered by Crystal Chips. It alchemically transforms chips into... Just about anything.

It’s not a secret that you have access to an inexhaustible source of Crystal Chips, and you know a thing or two about magic tech. So it was logical to contact you.

I’m willing to show you the schematic and see what you can learn.

Well, it looks functional. We need to determine whether its transmutation properties have a threshold... And unwanted side effects. Ancient mechanisms are infamous for that.

Keep me appraised.

What? What are you on about? I think that demon hit you too hard. There are no orc psionicists! You're just a weird shaman, hah.

And you should probably keep quiet about your... abilities.
r192273.n: I think I can read people's thoughts - is that normal for an orc?

t: Come closer, get some of that Patronage blessing!
r192274.n: Come closer, get some of that Patronage blessing!

t: Ahaha! What are you babbling... There are no orc psionicists! Or rather, we have yet to find them. But you're definitely not one of them. You're just a weird shaman!
What? No, you are destined to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc, and that's it.
r192295.n: I think I'm the one you need!

t: What? No, you are destined to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc, and that's it.
r192296.n: I think I'm the one you need!

t: Well? Why are you staring at me?
r192297.n: Well? Why are you staring at me?

t: Oh, I've been expecting you... Let's see... What, A7?! My last triple-decker... How dare you, Chonkina! Ugh. Please deliver this package to Verigin at once. He's going to be so upset...
What? Do you need something from me?
r192457.n: What? Do you need something from me?

t: Are you sure you want to teleport to Lab Thirteen?
Done! Now you can freely use Nezebgrad portals! But at first you'll have to report to every Keeper. Inform them that you are allowed to use the portals.

There is not much to tell, really.
Choose the track for your crab and place your bet. When the race starts, just stay close and cheer up your crab when you can. Our racing crabs are fierce beasts, they are agile and very voracious. The best way to cheer up a crab is to throw it some Delicate Crab Feed. You can find and collect this delicacy at the bottom of the sea.
When the race is over, come back to me and get your prize!

1st place - 12 Seashells,

2nd place - 8 Seashells,

3rd place - 6 Seashells,

4th place - 4 Seashells,

5th place - 3 Seashells,

6th place - 2 Seashells,

Choose a track to bet. Come on, there are no losers in crab racing!
You can change your mind before the race starts.

Once every few hours, I can suddenly announce a friendly race!

You will find out if I am going to organize a race as soon as my attraction opens. I will even give you a separate task for this!

If a race is planned, it will start five minutes before the end of my attraction, just like the sailboat races of the Aviaks.

You will need to start on my command together with all the other participants. And then just run as usual.

Come and get an additional reward!

r192982.n: Trade 10 Delicate Crab Feeds for 1 Seashell

r192983.n: Exchange 10 Crab Pills for a Seashell

r192992.n: Trade Summer Moon Suit for 1 Seashell

r192995.n: Trade Summer Moon Headgear for 1 Seashell

r192997.n: Trade a Shark Fin for 1 Seashell

r193003.n: Trade Sunny Steed bridle for 1 Seashell

r193005.n: Exchange Gryphon Feather for a seashell

t:
The third race of every hour is with random bets!

I'll roll the dice, and it will determine which crab your bet will land on. You can't change your bet, only wait until next time.

The risk is high, but the reward is also higher!

1st place - 25 shells,

2nd place - 20 shells,

3rd place - 15 shells,

4th place - 12 shells,

5th place - 10 shells,

6th place - 8 shells.
Hello! Do you want to enjoy the most spectacular and reckless gambling game of our island? Welcome to Crab Racing!
Blue Lagoon... Propeller... Hurricane... Sounds like a music to my ear!
Don't feel like collecting components yourself? I see. Choose whatever you want!

Oh, that's our favorite sports! We are good at running, but the most fun is trying to run when your legs stumble and everything doubles in your eyes. So much more challenging!
Point is, we have seven bars here at the Atoll, and you have to drink a cocktail in each.
The more drunk you are when you come to the bar, the more points you get! So drink bottoms up and run fast to the next bar, while the alcohol is still in your brain. If you manage to drink cocktails at all seven bars, you will receive the prize of a drunk marathoner!
Where do you get cocktails? There are two options. You can either buy them from bartenders, or pick up fruits and mix drinks yourself. You can learn cocktail recipes from me.
Oh, and there is a rule on our island: alcohol is prohibited unless you are participating in the Tipsy Marathon. Stay sober if you don't want to return early!
Fine. Go and pick your future pet.

Let me guess - the past few days weren't easy for him? It's not surprising - your pet exhausted himself and ate too much!

Bring me fat bugs and butterflies of all kinds, and I will prepare a special potion that will cheer the fledgling up.

r193563.n: Échangez des Marques de régate contre des Billets de loterie tropicale.

r193564.n: C'est parti ! La régate a lieu tous les jours à la même heure. Vous…

t:
Only those who completed a training with Gik are allowed to join!

Once you're done, come back.
r193565.n: Only those who completed a training with Gik are allowed to join! Once…

t: Come here, land dweller! I'll teach to you to soar like a bird!
r193616.n: Come here, land dweller! I'll teach to you to soar like a bird!

t:
A nice wind, isn't it?

Want to go sailing?
r193618.n: A nice wind, isn't it? Want to go sailing?

t:
The wind is too weak right now...

Come back later!
r193619.n: The wind is too weak right now... Come back later!

t:
First, you need a partner - can't play alone. Or better yet, four - the more players you have, the more points you earn. Hugi is always around, if there's no one else to play with.

You need to play in the court - and don't take the ball away from the court, or else it will leave you. Yes, it can do that.

To begin the game, you need to pick up the ball and serve it.

And then you need to run around and keep the ball from falling. And watch where you're sending the ball - turn to face the player you want to pass it to. Try to pick players who haven't hit the ball in a while. The more often everyone hits the ball, the more points you all get.

Try not to drop the ball. The longer the ball stays in the air, the more points everyone gets for hitting it.

For every ten hits, you get seashells. The more points you earn, the more seashells you get!
After running around after the ball for a bit, you should be able to beat monsters more easily. It will do you good!
r193635.n: After running around after the ball for a bit, you should be able to…

t: We're playing beach volleyball here. But the court is temporarily closed. I'll rake the sand and clean the ball - then we'll be open again!
r193636.n: We're playing beach volleyball here. But the court is temporarily…

t:
Oh! Karah-Oki is the most useful thing invented by the Waterfolk aside from the Hurricane cocktail.
Legend has it that the origin of Karah-Oki is associated with Oki the Thunderous, the most loud-voiced singer, and the Great Turtle who is peacefully sleeping at the bottom of the ocean. Oki knew only one song. But what a song it was! You could say it's our anthem! When he sang - he always sang when he was drunk, and Oki drank like a fish - you could hear him far beyond the island. Poor Oki's loud singing really got on the Great Turtle's nerves. She became angry and punished him. The old woman cast oblivion on poor Oki, and he forgot the words of our only song! What a tragedy... But that didn't stop us! We wrote the words of the song on boards and showed them to Oki whenever he started singing.
In the end, the Turtle forgave Oki, and everything ended well. And singing when you have lyrics showed to you? It stuck, and we named it Karah-Oki!
Do you want to participate? I'll handle the music and you will sing. You can do it! I believe in you.
Don't know the lyrics? Not a problem! Just watch me when you sing. I will show you the lyrics, so you can sing heartily without having to worry about anything. There are no bad songs, just bad listeners!
Just don't get carried away, otherwise it won't take long to get hoarse from Karah-Oki

Wow! You have a great gift for singing! It really tugs at heartstrings.
Here you go, lyrics for the next song. Don't mess up.
One... Two... Three... Go!
Careful with the rocket! No, you won't need a helmet, the water won't hurt you. Ready!
Perish the thought, you can't fly in such a weather. What if the wind blows you out into the Astral? Look up the calendar first.

Want to race my crabs? My pleasure. Don't be too disappointed if you lose, tho.
To boost you just a bit, I'll give you a rocket. You'll fly over the water, the crabs will run on feet. But they'll be ahead anyway, no one has beaten them so far. Try and catch the tailwind with the rocket, it'll help. And if you do outfly them - which, to tell you the truth, I sincerely doubt - I will give you a good reward!

Do you want to race my crabs? I'm afraid this is not the right time. The wrong winds are blowing. They might take you away to the Astral, so no flying just yet. Look up the next event in your calendar!
My crabs are faster than everyone else! Lightning always comes first, then it's Thunder and Breeze, and then all the rest.
r193698.n: My crabs are faster than everyone else! Lightning always comes first,…

t: No, not now, sorry. The Squawker is not ready to fly. Look up the event in your calendar.

It's not only birdies and butterflies that fly over the Atoll! We've raised a wonderful Squawker bird. He loves giving people rides!
He's not quite fully trained yet, but we're working on it. He's a great singer, too. When you ride him and hear him sing - encourage him, alright? No, not with treats - we feed him well enough, thank you. He loves fireworks! As soon as he starts singing - set off fireworks!
I'm sure you're going to love flying around. Just be careful not to fall off. Take a deep breath if your head starts spinning. Shut your eyes if the sun dazzles you. Cry if you feel like crying, shout if you feel like shouting! Enjoy the ride!
Do you want a ride? Such a pity, Squawker cannot fly right now. Look up the event in your calendar and come back.
r193716.n: Do you want a ride? Such a pity, Squawker cannot fly right now. Look…

t: They say, never shall those born to swim, learn to fly! Oh but yes we shall! I've been dreaming of flying since I was born, and now look, we've got our Squawker! Want a ride?
r193717.n: They say, never shall those born to swim, learn to fly! Oh but yes we…

t:
Quarr! It is time, yes? You'll get your equipment!

But I've run out of certain materials. Bring them to me - I'll give you a discount.

Bring me two dozen palm leaves, one tough pearl oyster shell, and 90 seashells.

Usually I take a hundred, but like I said - I'm giving you a discount!
r193857.n: I need equipment for my parrot

t:
Good!

Once your parrot's training is complete, come back here. I should be done by then.

It's ready! Take it!

Hold on tight, fly freely, and keep your eyes peeled to the sky!
Now go to the egg keeper and ask for an egg.

Complete my tasks, and I'll give you a token. Trade it for a Spark from the Wise Woman. Then I'll give you another task to help you raise your parrot.

But only once a day! Can't let the young parrot overexert himself!

Do you remember where the Wise Woman is? Her name is Willa.
r193868.n: How do I raise the parrot faster?

t: I have a new task for you.
r193869.n: I have a new task for you.

t: That's all for today! Come back tomorrow to get your new tasks.
r193870.n: That's all for today! Come back tomorrow to get your new tasks.

t: How is your feathered friend? Give him regards from me and my tribe!
r193871.n: How is your feathered friend? Give him regards from me and my tribe!

t:
Excellent fruit, juicy and tasty!

What should I add? Some rum? Perhaps tequila?
r193901.n: Ask for a juicy fruit cocktail

t:
Hello, hello!
Want a refreshing cocktail? Or do you need some exhilarating drink to make your blood run faster? Anything you like!
Or maybe you'd like to take part in our Tipsy Marathon and win "The Drunkest Runner" title!
Aha! I can see interest in your eyes! I knew that the marathon would intrigue you!
r193902.n: Hello, hello! Want a refreshing cocktail? Or do you need some…

t: Hey, pal! Wanna take part in the "Tipsy Marathon"? You'll enjoy it even if you don't win a prize!
r193922.n: Hey, pal! Wanna take part in the "Tipsy Marathon"? You'll enjoy it…

t:
Tipsy Marathon? You're a sportsman, that much is obvious!

The bartenders are still making cocktails for the next marathon, so go take a walk and come back later.

Clear your head before the competition!
r193923.n: Tipsy Marathon? You're a sportsman, that much is obvious! The…

t: Stand clear, landlubber. I'm busy scaring away giant crabs. You've seen none of those, you say? It means I'm doing a good job!
r193938.n: Who are you? What is your intention?

t: Well, here comes the terror of the depths!
r193943.n: Well, here comes the terror of the depths!

r193944.n: Parler des plongeons depuis les statues

t:
It's easy!

This happens every June now. The breeze carries the sea foam to shore, blowing bubbles all over the beach. I don’t know why the bubbles come out so rainbow-colored, but it’s a real feast for the eyes!

Of course, there are people who love popping them. At first I chased them away, but then I thought - why not?

If you want to try it, I'll give you the Frog Amulet so that you can jump high and far. The rest is simple - you jump towards the bubbles and they - pop! - burst.

Pop a hundred, and I'll give you shells. And we also consider it a special achievement to burst a dozen in one jump or a hundred in a minute. So if you want to show your special skills in catching bubbles, now is the time. There will be no bubbles in July!

When catching flying bubbles, you may accidentally come across a durable inflatable bubble. If you find one in your bag, take it out and try to inflate it.

Inflate carefully! If you see that the bubble has turned red, stop blowing and let it cool down a little until it's no longer red, then inflate it further. Just pay attention - it deflates over time when you are not blowing.

If you can blow a bubble the size of my house, you'll get a nice prize. And don't be upset if your bubble bursts - you will still get a reward. The bigger the bubble, the greater the reward.

That's it!
Just look how amazing they are! How beautifully they shimmer in the sun! And how loudly they burst!
r194014.n: Just look how amazing they are! How beautifully they shimmer in the…

t:
The bubbles are so beautiful and so fragile - they have all burst!

Come back a little later - soon the wind will bring a pile of new bubbles from the sea. Here, take a look at the calendar!
r194015.n: The bubbles are so beautiful and so fragile - they have all burst!…

t:
In June, the wind brings beautiful iridescent bubbles from the sea. Their time is over now, but next year they will return again.

Come visit me next summer if you want to chase after them.
r194016.n: In June, the wind brings beautiful iridescent bubbles from the sea.…

t:
Wow! What a catch! Lucky you!

Here are your 100 Seashells, like I promised! If you find another, bring it here, too.
r194067.n: Exchange the Black Pearl for 100 Seashells.

t:
Sometimes special pearl oysters appear in the sea. You can find a very valuable Black Pearl inside. If you find one, bring it to me before it becomes faded!

I will reward you generously!
r194068.n: Sometimes special pearl oysters appear in the sea. You can find a very…

t: There is no better place in Sarnaut than this hospitable island. A friendly tribe of the Great Turtle welcomes both Imperial citizens and League subjects. There is no place for long-standing fights at the resort - there is only sun, water, sand and entertainment. Crab racing, pub marathon, race and swim along the seashore, slot machines - there's entertainment for every fancy! To go there, you just need to buy a ticket from me given you have reached level 20.

Greetings!

Now when the fire was ceased on the frontline, the League and the Empire have finally made a step towards understanding. In order to establish friendly relations, it was decided to arrange a joint resort at the Tropical Atoll.

Oh, it's the best place in the world! Sunlit beaches, sand and palms! Smoothies, contests, prizes and fireworks... You should travel there, you won't regret!
r194105.n: Greetings! Now when the fire was ceased on the frontline, the League…

t:
Money? Hmm...
Hand it over and I'll give you the book! I'll be honest, I'm ashamed whenever I look at that poor sap... Who knew the book was so valuable to him? I sure didn't!
r194388.n: Offer five silver coins for the book

t: What? What do you need? I don't know anything. I'm clear! I haven't heard anything about a book! Err... oops!
r194389.n: What? What do you need? I don't know anything. I'm clear! I haven't…

t:
It's all very simple! You rent a safe deposit box where you can store whatever you want. The cell is not bottomless, you can't fit a lot in there. For a fee you can buy additional deposit boxes to meet your storage needs.

You have so many trophies that your safe deposit box is bursting at the seams? Not a problem! Goblin Banker is ready to provide special deposit boxes with increased capacity in exchange for Expansion Tokens. You can get Expansion Tokens in exchange for all kinds of bags.

Yes, yes, you heard right - a good roomy bag is now a rarity: you can get it as a reward for thoroughly exploring Tep's Pyramid on Irdrich, saving Catherina on the Eclipse, defeating Bedlam at the Winter Palace, surviving the Battle of Gods, and defeating Kyros on the Secret Paths.

An experienced warrior can earn a modest bag on the Battlegrounds, and brave explorers can try their luck in combat with the strongest opponents on the islands in the Astral and at the Observatory on high difficulty.

There are different types of mounts! Horses are the most common ones. They are beautiful and well-built... Lions, and wolves, and gryphons, are more exotic. Who knows what animal will be tamed or domesticated another day... Mounts are for traveling. However, they are so charming!

Color Patterns change the color of your mount. You can buy them at the Boutique or find them in your adventures in Far Astral. Remember, once you get a pattern, it's yours forever, even if you get rid of the mount
Nowadays, a race horse is not a luxury but a means of transport!
r194576.n: Nowadays, a race horse is not a luxury but a means of transport!

t:
Another gift from the Dark God who calls himself the Overlord. This item operates on other principles of magic, so it was very difficult to reproduce it in our world. However, the Great Mages unraveled the secret, and the Free Traders immediately started collecting copies.

This is a fast and versatile vehicle. An excellent combat unit. When falling from a great height, it takes no damage. Can swim on or under water, and has many other abilities that weaken enemies.

Lightning Bolt is a unique machine based on the technology developed by the sorceress Catherina. It's one of the world's fastest combat machines that takes no damage from falling from a height and can instantly cover large distances.

Lightning Bolt is now one of the most popular combat mounts. The chassis designed by the Kanian sorceress was later used to create numerous modifications.
r194578.n: Lightning Bolt is a unique machine based on the technology developed…

t:
The Manabike is a device with an interesting history. The blueprints of its engines were gathering dust in the archives of the House de Ardeur for a long time until they were stolen by the brave Imperial spy Boleslav Fortochkin. Nezebgrad scientists have been working on the prototype for several years, hoping to create a high-speed courier transport for the front. Their efforts came to nothing, so the project was stowed away in the archives for a long time.

It would have continued to gather dust if one Goblin Banker hadn't learned about it. The famous businessman bought the patent from the Empire and completed the development at his own expense. Today the Manabike is the fastest vehicle in all of Sarnaut.

The Manabike comes with a special protective headgear - the Pilot's Helmet.
r194580.n: The Manabike is a device with an interesting history. The blueprints…

t:
Not so long ago, the war between the League and the Empire would not subside. Scientists and mages racked their brains over new blueprints and spells, trying to one-up their enemies.

This time, another leap in the development of combat mechanisms took place in the secret laboratory of the Death Plant. The rebels from among the Free Traders managed to complete an order that was supposed to greatly strengthen the position of the Empire on the frontiers. However, as a result of the intrigues of intelligence officers and saboteurs of the League, the secret schematics became... not so secret. Thus, the armies of both factions received a fundamentally new combat mechanism - the Spinner!

 It doesn't take damage when falling from a height, doesn't sink, doesn't slow down in water, and its powerful combat skills will make quick work of enemies.
r194581.n: Not so long ago, the war between the League and the Empire would not…

t:
In 1012, archaeologists discovered another treasury of the Junes. Among the ancient artifacts, they found something absolutely unprecedented - a huge combat machine designed in the image and likeness of a man. The power of June technology is well known to every hero of Sarnaut, but this mechanism looked better than the most complex golems. There was no doubt - the archaeologists managed to find one of the greatest inventions of the ancient race. More importantly, detailed blueprints for this device were stored in the treasury! Today, the League and the Empire are ready to arm themselves with a new type of military equipment known as the Titan!

The first model of the Titan was created by Kanian engineers, and it was this model that was later copied by the Free Traders.

Later a Colossus modification was created, an autonomous mechanism used by all engineers of Sarnaut these days.

Who is this Overlord, you ask? That's what Nihaz's minions call him - the God of Darkness who appeared in Sarnaut not so long ago. The throne is one of the implements of war that were granted to his apprentices. Many of our heroes were among them. Oh, this vehicle did not come from our world - it was created using technologies that our world does not even know. I know the Overlord's Servants themselves use it to fight against his enemies.

The Throne is an excellent defensive combat unit. Overlord's Throne is very difficult to destroy. Additionally, it has two modes: the Travel Mode and the Destruction Mode which allow the owner to easily change tactics on the battlefield.
r194584.n: Who is this Overlord, you ask? That's what Nihaz's minions call him -…

t:
This time, the Elves and Kanians acted as the developers of the combat mechanism. The most ancient race of Sarnaut and master mechanics created a truly wonderful invention - the embodiment of magic and subtle engineering!

This creation is ideal for a sudden attack on the enemy, because the manned vehicle can become invisible and quickly move around the area. It also has abilities that can protect a friendly target from any damage and slow down enemies.

You don't know what a mortar is? Ah, youngsters... Well, it's a Kanian thing, so if you are not from Mother Kania, then it is forgivable. But if you're Kanian, then shame on you!

In short, a mortar is a hollowed out piece of log. What is it for, you ask? To crush things. Grain or hemp - it's what simple peasants do.

And where there are peasants, there are superstitions. And superstitions mean there are witches! Are you catching on?

I don’t know which old hag thought of enchanting a mortar to fly around in, but the witches fell in love with this household item. It's way more comfortable than a broomstick!

Well, as the authorities started taking witches and sorcerers into their service, mortars came into fashion. It's sort of exotic, a real fairy tale!
r194587.n: Ask about the mount: Baba Yaga's Pestle

t:
What is surprising here? Yes, a bear! Have you ever heard the fairy tale about Masha? Masha sat in a box of pies that the bear was carrying, and she was eating pies as they went along. Everything was fine, but then the bear got hungry... Yeah... It didn't end well.

But don't be afraid. Our bears are well-mannered, so they won't hurt you.

But this beast is formidable, and it will be a threat to any enemy.

So it's not surprising that as soon as the Kanians put fighting bears into the line of fire, Xadagan initiated the Red Alert project and started training circus bears.

Bees? Well, bees are quite similar to beetles - they buzz, fly, and they can sting you. And it hurts!

With the advent of the Astral, everything keeps getting bigger. They say that in the distant astral plane there is an archipelago of eight islands - and on one of them everything is gigantic, even things that are not supposed to be this big.

That's why I'm not surprised by riding bees. I hear they use some kind of inner magic to collect honey from flowers around them. If such a bee stops somewhere, small bees will fly to it, believing it to be their queen.

So. The beetle. Yes, it happens. They came here from the southern lands where they crawled around the pyramids and rolled balls of manure, but the local sorcerers came up with the idea of riding them. Made the beetles several times bigger.

They turned out to be decent aeronautical mounts. They fly around, buzzing and causing panic.

When the world split and the Astral appeared, other beetles began to grow, too. Now they're everywhere, so don't be surprised if you see a winged dragonfly elf riding a beetle!
r194590.n: So. The beetle. Yes, it happens. They came here from the southern…

t:
Have you ever seen a broom? Oh, you don't know anything about physical work, do you? You just beat up monsters and break things.

But oh well. A broom is one thing, but flying on it is quite another. Witches came up with it, of course. It's not too tricky - you enchant a stick, then mount it and fly. And what's always at hand? A broom, of course.

However, people are still skeptical about it. Well, only in fairy tales would some guy fly like a bird in the sky. Can you even stay on the broom long enough to take off?

So it's a rare commodity. Only on the Chicken Day, which the clergy call the All Hallows Day, can you buy this curiosity...
r194591.n: Ask about the mount: Witch's Broom

t:
The history of Manamobiles is interesting...

It happened in the Empire. Somehow they created an experimental wagon at one of the factories - one that would carry two at a time and could be equipped with a cannon. It's our answer to Catherina's Lightning, they say. But cheaper.

But no matter how hard the Zem engineers and Xadaganians tried, it wouldn't move an inch - didn't even rise from the ground. So they hauled the prototypes off to the scrapyard. Well, the chief engineer is walking home after his shift when he spots a familiar mechanic standing at that scrapyard - an orc named Jack the Deft. The engineer decides to play a joke on him. "The car broke down," he says. "And no one can fix it. Can you do it, Jack? I bet a bottle of vodka that you can't fix it."

The orc scratched his head, and they shook on it.

The next morning, the engineer comes to the scrapyard and sees the car rumbling a yard above the ground. He drops his jaw. And comes closer. For half an hour, he looks at it from all sides, yelling, "How in the world?!" "No way!" But he lost the bet.

They decided to hire Jack, but it turned out that all the unassembled cars had already been sent to Suslanger - to the graveyard for old astral ships in the desert.

But the Orcs are skilled guys - they quickly found a use for them. And by then, the Xadaganian plant had begun producing Manamobiles. Even the Free Traders got the blueprints in exchange for a supply of new engines.

Cats. Have you ever heard that cats are bred by Tekyan monks on the top of the Crystal Mountain?

Well, have you ever been there? Did you see any cats there? Or monks? There you go.

Advertising is the force of progress, or so the Free Traders say. Simply put, you can make money just by embellishing some story. Cats, on the other hand, have the most trivial origins. It's connected to the influence of the Astral. The fact is, after the world split into allods, all the animals on our islands began to grow in size. At first, it became noticeable on Umoir, and they thought the Demon was behind it. But then the same thing happened on Yazes, the Kanian Archipelago, Gipat, Igsh... Everywhere. By our eleventh century, they have grown bigger. It does not affect all of them. For some reason, sentient ones are unaffected, but it happened to every other wild cat out there. Hence the giant cats. We found them on some of the distant islands, decided they were cute, and put them to work. We entrusted this job to one ingenious mage named Yura the Dollmaker.

So he trained the cats, and now they serve as mounts and know all sorts of tricks.

They are just adorable... Even the most vicious Orc Punisher would be charmed.

Oh, what a marvel. Some skald would probably say. But I know a thing or two about history and can responsibly declare that chariots are not a new invention. It was simply forgotten. They were invented by the Aro tribes who were the first to tame horses. It was on the border with the Orcs' steppes. Back when the dragons still existed, the Orcs occupied only a part of those steppes. At the time, the future Kanians used wagons and chariots but didn't ride any animals.

 I'm not surprised this idea was revived on Ammer where they decided to arrange a bull race. After all, horse races already exist; they also ride golems and even fly as Sparks - why shouldn't there be chariots?

So this forgotten idea has become a novelty again. The elves remembered it first..

Birds? Why not? I've probably said that in recent centuries - all sorts of creatures appeared on allods, and many became popular. Among them are all sorts of winged flyers like crows, jays, parrots.

Everyone wants to stand out these days, so they look for more exotic mounts.

The crows are popular because of witches. They love these birds which suit their gloomy disposition.

The jays are another miracle - a magical bird that flies through the astral plane and brings cold.

And finally, a parrot - this guest from the tropics is the pet of the Aviaks who love bright and colorful things.

Or maybe another bird will appear soon... There are also owls, but it's a different story...

A sled dog? Why not?

As long as it's big enough. And we have plenty of those dogs. There are all kinds of breeds - fighting, shepherd, hounds...

The first dog of this kind came out of an imperial laboratory - sorry, I don’t remember which one. The idea was this - to give the scouts a pet so they could carry their masters and sniff out enemies. So they trained some.

The idea was good. The Kanian intelligence found out and got some dogs for themselves. Now they are everywhere...
